title: Powers in the image and nilpotent kernel give a spectrum homeomorphism
statement: Let $f:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings. Assume every element of $\ker f$ is nilpotent and for every $s\in S$ there exists an integer $d>0$ with $s^d\in f(R)$. Then the map $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, $\mathfrak q\mapsto f^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$, is a homeomorphism of the underlying Zariski topological spaces [def-weil-affine-spectrum].
